Highland Capital Management Lp bought 26,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.23% with the market. The hedge fund run by James Dondero held 139,330 shares of the central company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.37M, up from 113,330 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Highland Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Pampa Energia S A for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.15B market cap company.
